data.name: Logix Video Card for S-100

introduced.event_name: NCC 1979 — Apple II and S-100 expansion launch

data.description: Logix-developed open-ecosystem expansion, independent of DRI’s development obligations.

specification.host_interface: Configurable 8-bit S-100 interface; qualify address decode, waits, power and conflicts on named systems.
specification.software: CP/M BIOS adapters, installation diagnostics and optional Platform Extensions/TUI support for qualified 8080/Z80 hosts; declare ISA and memory prerequisites.
specification.sourcing: AION silicon at June 1979 launch; qualified SMC equivalents eligible only after the relevant part release, no earlier than October 1979.
specification.host_access: Windowed/addressed access to onboard video RAM; onboard display refresh continues independently. No extra general-purpose host RAM is implied.
specification.display_modes: Reuse Aurelia controller text/bitmap capabilities subject to card/monitor qualification. 80-column output requires a compatible 640-pixel monitor. Host CPU determines drawing throughput.
specification.sprite_policy: All five sprites in every supported Aurelia-family mode using exclusive 1 KiB SRAM; host-specific upload interface. No Aurelia system DMA controller on this card.

manufacturing_requirements: Freeze host decode, pinout, power and timings; select physical buffers/transceivers and PCB stack-up.
Release driver/ROM image and test on named host configurations; host and monitor sold separately.
Release assembly routing, test fixtures and procurement specifications.
Qualify 16 KiB video RAM window access, controller arbitration, monitor capability negotiation and maximum supported video mode.
